title: Operational capacity appears constrained
management_question: Which work centres are genuinely capacity constrained and what is driving the load?
rationale: 1 material signal(s) across PEO-04 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
next_step: Validate hours and constraints, then test overtime, bottlenecks, scheduling, mix and investment options before monetising.
limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

supporting_evidence.core_question: Where is practical workforce capacity constrained or underused, and how much capacity is genuinely evidenced?
supporting_evidence.evidence_summary: Assembly: practical capacity 3234 hours, actual productive hours 3370, utilisation 104.2053184910327767470624613%. Over/unused capacity is operational evidence only; no financial saving or causal conclusion is inferred.

recommended_actions.recommended_action: Validate bottleneck load and test scheduling, overtime, mix, process and investment alternatives before monetising.
recommended_actions.evidence_required: Validated practical capacity, productive hours, overtime, throughput, scrap/downtime and contribution at constraint.
recommended_actions.limitation: Recommended action is an investigation/intervention path, not proof of causality or benefit.
